# @immediately-run/grove — the viewer kit for directory-as-content wikis

> The Grove viewer: a kit of React components, layouts and themes for building immediately.run wikis. Composable as a fork, a dispatch target, or a pinned library. (v0.2.1)

Grove is NOT a wiki engine: routing, MDX compilation, the frontmatter index, link
spaces and heading anchors live in the sandbox + `@immediately-run/sdk`. What this
package owns is the component vocabulary, the chrome, the layout chain, the themes,
and the defaults. Three composition modes (PLATFORM_LAYERING_SPEC §1.1):

- **M1 dispatch** — a content repo with `opensWith: {task: "open-wiki"}` resolves here;
  you write no code, the host mounts the corpus.
- **M2 fork** — engine + corpus in one repo (the docs wiki shape).
- **M3 library** — a thin shell imports this package pinned and composes it:
  see `examples/thin-shell/`, and the override contract below.

## Import surface (package.json exports)

- `@immediately-run/grove` → ./src/lib.ts
- `@immediately-run/grove/app` → ./src/App.tsx
- `@immediately-run/grove/manifest` → ./viewer.manifest.json
- `@immediately-run/grove/components` → ./src/mdxComponents.ts
- `@immediately-run/grove/styles.css` → ./src/GroveApp.css
- `@immediately-run/grove/theme.css` → ./src/index.css
- `@immediately-run/grove/package.json` → ./package.json

## Component vocabulary — the override contract (viewer.manifest.json)

This is THE two-way surface: what a corpus may use, and what a library-composing
shell may override. `composeComponents(base, overrides)` THROWS on a name that is
not declared here or is declared `overridable: false` — overriding never silently
no-ops. Tiers: `engine` renders any corpus · `chrome` is site furniture · `corpus`
is one corpus's conventions (declared by that corpus, not this repo).

- `a` (engine, overridable) — Wiki-link resolver: renders the resolved / broken / self states for an in-corpus href. Props: href: string?, children: node?.
- `Backlinks` (engine, overridable) — Entries linking to this one.
- `Callout` (engine, overridable) — An aside block with a kind (note / warning / …). Props: kind: string?, title: string?, children: node?.
- `ChildPages` (engine, overridable) — The entries nested under this one.
- `Directory` (engine, overridable) — The entries under one corpus directory. Props: path: string?.
- `DirectoryList` (engine, overridable) — A folder listing as a table, with metadata columns chosen by `columns` and narrowed to those the rows actually carry. Props: path: string?, title: string?, columns: string?, sort: string?, hidden: boolean?.
- `DocList` (engine, overridable) — A queried list of entries — the generic index primitive. paginate="infinite" windows it with a sentinel and a stated end (R3-314); the attribute must be a literal. Props: tag: string?, limit: number?, paginate: 'infinite'?, batch: number?.
- `DocsByTag` (engine, overridable) — Entries grouped under one tag. Props: tag: string?.
- `FamilyTree` (engine, overridable) — A relationship graph rendered from frontmatter links. Props: children: node?.
- `GroveFooter` (chrome, overridable) — The site footer.
- `GroveNav` (chrome, overridable) — Top/side navigation. Reads the shell context, so an override must too (or render its own).
- `GroveSidebar` (chrome, overridable) — The corpus tree sidebar.
- `img` (engine, overridable) — Resolves a mount-relative asset off the filesystem. Props: src: string?, alt: string?.
- `Infobox` (engine, overridable) — The boxed summary panel a wiki entry carries beside its lede. Props: title: string?, children: node?.
- `Kbd` (engine, overridable) — A keyboard key. Props: children: node?.
- `KeyValue` (engine, overridable) — A definition-list row for infobox-style facts. Props: children: node?.
- `LayoutGallery` (engine, overridable) — The layouts gallery: the starters, page variants and collection shapes grouped by their three mechanisms, enumerated from this manifest.
- `Lede` (engine, overridable) — The opening paragraph, set apart typographically. Props: children: node?.
- `More` (engine, overridable) — A 'read more' pointer to a related entry. Props: href: string?, children: node?.
- `Outlet` (engine, LOCKED) — The layout chain's inward slot. NOT overridable — the chain's nesting is engine mechanics, and replacing it detaches every layer from the page it wraps.
- `PageMeta` (engine, overridable) — The entry's own metadata line (updated, reading time, …).
- `Quote` (engine, overridable) — A pull quote with an optional citation. Props: cite: string?, children: node?.
- `RecentlyUpdated` (engine, overridable) — The most recently updated entries. Props: limit: number?.
- `TableOfContents` (engine, overridable) — The on-this-page heading list, which keeps the active entry in view as the reader scrolls. Props: entryKey: string?, title: string?, className: string?.
- `TagCloud` (engine, overridable) — Every tag in the corpus, weighted by use. Props: limit: number?.
- `TagList` (engine, overridable) — The tags of one entry, as links to their indexes. Props: tags: string[]?.
- `ThemeGallery` (engine, overridable) — The themes gallery: one row per shipped theme, enumerated from this manifest — adding a theme adds a row with no edit to the entry.
- `Timeline` (engine, overridable) — A dated sequence of entries or events. Props: children: node?.
- `Toc` (engine, overridable) — The table of contents derived from the entry's heading anchors. Props: depth: number?.

## Frontmatter keys the engine reads

- `site`
- `theme`
- `stylesheets`
- `layout`
- `view`
- `frame`
- `render`
- `nav`
- `order`
- `tags`
- `cover`

Unknown keys pass through (carried, unread) — a corpus may keep its own vocabulary.

## What lives one layer down (do not reimplement here)

- Platform client (RPC, capabilities, mounts, fs, editor, LLM): `@immediately-run/sdk`
  — its llms.txt: https://immediately-run.github.io/immediately-run-sdk/llms.txt
- Link-space resolver + grammar canon: `@immediately-run/mdx-plugins`
- Non-executable MDX rendering: `@immediately-run/safe-content`
